findings.message: `FirstOrDefaultAsync` returns null when no order has the given id, so `order.Total` throws a `NullReferenceException` for a missing order instead of reporting a clear not-found condition. Callers cannot tell a missing order apart from a real fault, which also makes the controller rule about returning `NotFound()` hard to follow.
findings.suggestion: return order?.Total ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Order {id} was not found.");
